_comment: aces golden path rig solvers (aces-os src/aces-engineering, image aces-golden:0.1). A drop-in so simlab/solvers.json is never rewritten; these rows win over same-named rows there. golden.* says which golden code the image carries; validation stays pending until scripts/golden_validate.py passes on the rig with that image id (docs/GOLDEN_RIG.md).

golden-case.description: aces golden path, one sweep design on a rig GPU: SIMP (gendesign.topopt3d) -> organic implicit skin -> voxel FEA (step-structures stage_solve, Jacobi-PCG FP64), run by aces_engineering.golden.case inside the aces-golden image

validation.note: pending until case GK-1 of scripts/golden_validate.py passes on the rig with this image (docs/GOLDEN_RIG.md)

golden-check.description: aces golden path finer-resolution independent check on a rig GPU: a verified part.stl re-voxelised at the check resolution (or a supplied mask) and solved by aces_engineering.golden.fea (step-structures stage_solve; Jacobi-PCG, or geometric-multigrid PCG on the solid-only operator for one-component masks from 200,000 cells), FP64

validation.note: pending until cases GC-1, GC-2 and GC-3 of scripts/golden_validate.py pass on the rig with this image

ccx-check.description: aces golden path conforming second discretisation on the rig CPU: gmsh 4.15.2 C3D10 (tet10) mesh of a verified part.stl, CalculiX ccx 2.23 linear static with the spec's supports and tractions mapped onto the mesh surface

validation.note: pending until cases CC-1 and CC-2 of scripts/golden_validate.py pass on the rig with this image
